title: Vibe Coding Is The Future
summary: A Y Combinator video on vibe coding, the term Andrej Karpathy coined for letting LLMs write code. It reports what YC founders say about debugging, models and how much of their code is AI-written.
why: HN mostly cites it critically, as a source for the claim that much of YC code is AI-written and as an example of insiders promoting vibe coding.

quote.text: some industry insiders, for instance YC are releasing videos like this: "Vibe Coding Is The Future
